errors.text_span: two nested pie charts, or sunburst diagrams
errors.evidence: The figure shows two separate pie charts side by side, not nested/sunburst diagrams. Sunburst diagrams have concentric rings representing hierarchy, but these are standard single-level pie charts with labels and arrows.

errors.text_span: The segments are grouped by color into an inner ring of broad categories and an outer ring of subcategories
errors.evidence: The charts are single-ring pie charts, not multi-ring charts. There is no inner/outer ring structure visible in the figure.

errors.text_span: Its inner ring features mint green Education 25, orange History & Society 23, light blue Health & Medicine 22, pink-red Science 15, brown Tech & Engineer 12, and cyan Fin & Law 3. Its corresponding outer ring contains mint green Teaching & resources 15
errors.evidence: The left chart is a single pie chart. The numbers like 'Education 25', 'Teaching & resources 15' etc. are all segments of the same single pie chart, not separated into inner and outer rings.

errors.text_span: The right chart contains 21 total slices (6 inner and 15 outer). The inner ring consists of mint green Education 38
errors.evidence: The right chart is also a single pie chart, not a two-ring chart. All segments including 'Education 38' are part of one single pie.

errors.text_span: numerical values—which sum to 100 in the inner rings, indicating percentages
errors.evidence: The numbers shown are not necessarily percentages summing to 100; they appear to be cluster counts or raw numbers, not percentages. The sum of all values in the left chart exceeds 100 (e.g., 25+23+22+15+12+3 already = 100 for the supposed inner ring alone, but many more segments exist).
The description does not clearly state that these are clustering statistics showing the distribution of document clusters across topics, as indicated by the caption.

errors.text_span: a small cyan slice labeled with an ellipsis (...)
errors.evidence: There is no slice labeled with an ellipsis (...) visible in the right chart. The description invents this element.

In the right chart, the label visible appears as 'Tech & Engineer 8' but it is difficult to confirm it as brown; it appears as a brownish/dark color similar to left chart but the description should note this is an approximation.
